value.rationale: Biroli et al. motivate dynamically generated energy correlations from a shared switching trap, with positive sign for identical responses. The new exact sign and no-accidental-zero classification identifies a meaningful opposite-response physical regime with negative energy coupling, even though Gaussian positional covariance is identically zero, and is uniform over all positive switching and thermal parameters. This exact finite structural invariant does not require a downstream theorem to be useful.
